LESSON: KUANDIKA 10.3.1 BARUA RASMI YA KUOMBA KAZI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 10
Topic 10.3: Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
2. kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
3. kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi akizingatia vipengele vyake

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi akizingatia vipengele vyake
   In simple words: practise until you can kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi akizingatia vipengele vyake. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi in the examples.
2. Explain Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kuandika 10.3.1 Barua Rasmi ya Kuomba Kazi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
2. kutambua vipengele vya barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi
3. kuandika barua rasmi ya kuomba kazi akizingatia vipengele vyake

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
